What Apple Safety Check is — Emergency Reset vs Manage Sharing & Access

Apple ships Safety Check on iPhone under Settings → Privacy & Security → Safety Check (zh-Hans: 设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 安全检查). Two flows your US listing may show on gallery frames:

  • Emergency Reset — immediately stop sharing location, stop sharing with people and apps, reset privacy permissions, and sign out of iCloud on device when someone needs to cut shared access fast; 紧急重置, 停止共享位置, 重置隐私权限
  • Manage Sharing & Access — step through what is shared — people, apps, devices, location — review shared access, then remove access selectively; 管理共享与访问, 检查共享权限

Third-party apps may complement this by educating buyers, aligning privacy UX with shared-access awareness, or documenting honest scope. AppLocale rewrites listing copy from what your US page already claims — not Check In ETA sharing, not Emergency SOS dial-out, not Medical ID cards.

Safety Check–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Shared-access review marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Safety Check — not a literal paste of US marketing:

设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 安全检查 (Safety Check settings path)

Apple's Chinese Settings path is 设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 安全检查. Screenshot captions that walk buyers to the tool should use the Chinese settings path buyers see on device, not English "Privacy & Security → Safety Check" badges alone.

紧急重置 (Emergency Reset)

US pages use "Emergency Reset" when describing the flow that immediately stops sharing location, stops sharing with people and apps, and resets privacy permissions. China storefront copy uses 紧急重置 on frames that explain fast shared-access cutoff — not 紧急SOS (Emergency SOS side-button call) unless your English source genuinely shows SOS UI.

管理共享与访问 (Manage Sharing & Access)

When your English subtitle says "Manage Sharing & Access" or "Review shared access step by step," zh-Hans buyers search 管理共享与访问 and 检查共享权限. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual gallery frames — people list vs app permissions vs location sharing.

停止共享位置 (stop sharing location)

Safety Check Emergency Reset stops location sharing with people and apps. zh-Hans marketing uses 停止共享位置 when the screenshot shows location-revocation benefits — distinct from Find My item tracking (查找) or Check In ETA sharing (分享预计到达时间).

重置隐私权限 (reset privacy permissions)

Emergency Reset resets privacy permissions across apps. zh-Hans copy may use 重置隐私权限 on benefit frames — not generic 隐私设置 unless your English source uses that phrasing.
